name: EMT development pipeline comparison
notes: Both conditions use real EMT images and human-labeled tracks, not detector predictions.
Several pipeline components changed: evidence selection, image views, derived facts and answer review. Differences do not isolate a training effect.
Question and review development used these clips. This is not a held-out accuracy estimate.
Reviews are independent AI-assisted assessments with student verification pending.
No retrieval answer key is supplied for this historical comparison; answer-review counts must not be described as retrieval accuracy.
Historical run folders and processed images remain local and are not included in the repository. Manifest review bindings identify these exact saved result files.
